## TRU — CY2025 Q3 (ended 2025-09-30) vs CY2025 Q2 (ended 2025-06-30), selected SEC rows

**Scope note.** All changes below are **sequential quarter-over-quarter**, not year over year. Figures are selected exhibit rows, not complete filings; absence of an item here is not evidence of its absence from the filing. Guidance figures are forward-looking and are kept separate from realized results.

### 1. What the selected rows show

**GAAP operating line improved.** Revenue +29.8 to 1169.5 and operating expenses +14.4 to 961.9 → operating income +15.4 to 207.6 (exact identity).

**GAAP below the line reversed that gain.** Nonoperating moved −22.1 to −57.5 → pretax income −6.7 to 150.1 (exact). Tax −5.6 to −50.0 → net income −12.2 to 100.2 (residual 0.1, within rounding tolerance). NCI −0.8 to −3.6 → attributable net income −13.0 to 96.6 (exact); GAAP diluted EPS −0.07 to 0.49.

**Non-GAAP moved the opposite way.** Adjusted EBITDA +18.1 to 425.1, but only +2.1 came from EBITDA (345.8) and +15.9 from EBITDA adjustments (79.2) (residual 0.1). Adjusted net income +3.4 to 216.5 decomposes exactly into attributable GAAP net income −13.0, adjusted net pretax items +16.2, adjusted net tax items +0.2. Adjusted diluted EPS +0.02 to 1.10.

### 2. Supported implication
The quarter is **two-track, not uniformly improving**: operating profitability rose sequentially, while GAAP attributable earnings and GAAP EPS fell. The non-GAAP improvement is attributable mainly to a larger adjustment add-back rather than to EBITDA itself. That is an accounting-bridge observation — the selected rows do not identify what the adjustments or the nonoperating charge consist of, so no causal driver is asserted.

### 3. Guidance vs realized (displayed values only)
Realized GAAP revenue 1169.5 vs guided 1115–1135; adjusted EBITDA 425.1 vs guided 397–411; GAAP diluted EPS 0.49 vs guided 0.39–0.44; adjusted diluted EPS 1.10 vs guided 0.99–1.04; attributable income 96.6 vs guided 78–87. Each realized figure sits above its guided range high on a displayed-value basis. No midpoint percentage change, percentage-point spread, or beat/miss magnitude is asserted, and no management reconciliation of guidance to actuals is present in the extract.

### 4. Material counterevidence
- GAAP attributable net income and GAAP diluted EPS declined sequentially while adjusted measures rose — the GAAP/non-GAAP gap widened.
- The adjusted EBITDA gain is dominated by adjustments (+15.9) rather than EBITDA (+2.1).
- The pretax decline is driven by the nonoperating line, whose composition is not in the extract.

### 5. Missing evidence
Composition of EBITDA adjustments and of the nonoperating charge; segment and organic-vs-inorganic revenue split; share count and dilution; tax-rate drivers; cash flow and leverage; management explanation of guidance vs actuals; year-over-year comparatives.

### 6. Research-state decision
